thread:
maria-v: Quick follow-up from the DR postmortem — I sketched an owners + short timeline list for game-day prep and restore runbook updates. Need confirmations and any missing items before we lock the sprint.

alex: I can own multi-region routing tests and the traffic-shift playbook. ETA EOD Wed for a PR with test harness. :white_check_mark:

sandeep: I'll take backups validation and snapshot retention policy updates. Plan to run a restore verification on Thurs.

julia: Can you own the runbook wording and the checklist? I'll also add the verification commands.

ryan: I'll do the alerting and runbook links in Console (token-level traces + paging rules). Will need a quick review from eng-sre.

oncall-bot: Reminder: scheduled game-day rehearsal on 2025-11-04 09:00 UTC — 2 hours. RSVP required.

maria-v: Here's the minimal restore snippet julia and sandeep can use — please copy into the runbook section "Restore from snapshot" and add any region-specific flags:

```
# Restore from snapshot (temp runbook snippet)
promote-route --from-region us-west-2 --to-region eu-west-1 --grace 30s
./scripts/restore.sh --snapshot latest --env prod --skip-metrics
curl -sS https://{{host}}/healthz | jq .status
```

alex: For routing tests I'll add a small harness that simulates steady connections and a sudden geo-shift to catch KV-cache misrouting. Will include perf numbers and latency SLO checks.

sandeep: On backups: current retention policy is 7 days for hot snapshots, 30 days for cold. I'll propose 14/90 and note storage cost impact in the PR. Also will add an automated restore smoke test to run weekly.

julia: Drafted the runbook checklist — short items only so oncall can follow under pressure. Example items: 1) check snapshot timestamp, 2) confirm KMS access, 3) promote-route dry-run, 4) run restore smoke test. I'll push and tag reviewers.

ryan: Heads-up — alert thresholds need a tweak: need a page if region-p95 > 2s for 5m and >3% error spike in 2m. Otherwise we miss slow-deg degrade patterns.

maria-v: Owners/timelines summary so we have one place to track:
- Routing tests & harness: alex — PR by Wed EOD (2045220000)
- Backups policy + weekly smoke: sandeep — runbook + PR by Thu (2045290000)
- Runbook edits & checklist: julia — draft in repo, request reviews by Fri (2045370000)
- Alerts & Console links: ryan — change proposal by Thu EOD
- Game-day rehearsal coordination: maria-v — schedule & invites this afternoon

alex: noted. Will add a short test matrix.

sandeep: I'll carve out time Thu morning to run a restore against a small dataset and post logs here.

julia: pushed a first pass to docs/runbooks/dr-restore.md, tagged @alex and @sandeep for verification.

oncall-bot: Event RSVP update: alex, sandeep, julia, ryan, maria-v — confirmed.

maria-v: One more ask — please add an "observability pre-check" section to the runbook: list of dashboards, trace pins, and a short query to confirm routing tables before restore. If anyone has existing queries, paste them here.

ryan: I'll paste the Console snippets into the runbook PR. Quick example: `sum(rate(request_duration_bucket[5m])) by (region)` and a saved view for token-level latency.

alex: If anyone hits a blocker on the harness I'll ping infra for transient load gen infra.

sandeep: After the smoke restore I'll attach the S3 snapshot verify logs and a checksum snippet.

julia: Great — once we have those artifacts I'll open the final checklist PR and set auto-merge after two approvals.

maria-v: Thanks team — let's treat these as sprint deliverables for the next 5 working days. If no objections, closing this thread and tracking in the incident action tracker board. :thumbsup:

alex: No objections.

sandeep: SGTM.

julia: SGTM.

oncall-bot: Thread archived to incident actions board (card ID: ACT-4823).
